answer_1.quote: Abstractive multi-document summarization (MDS) aims to generate coherent and concise summaries from sets of related documents.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate summary informativeness with ROUGE and BertScore, coherence with DiscoScore, faithfulness with our new MDSummaC metric, and abstractiveness with Ngram Novelty.

answer_4.quote: We hired a group of three native English speakers to act as human evaluators of the generated summaries... We use Xiao et al.'s guidelines for fluency evaluation, measuring grammaticality, referential clarity, and structure & coherence.
answer_4.guideline: Xiao et al.'s guidelines for fluency evaluation, with comparative ranking of system outputs.
